subject: Over capacity this week — can APS take a few more?
body:
Hi APS team,

Rough weekend here — we're over capacity and I'm trying to move a few dogs before Thursday. Any chance you all could take 2-3 extra smalls this week, outside the usual pull? Totally understand if you're full.

Rosa
San Benito County Animal Services
gt_facts: True capacity: 27 fosters who have fostered before are currently free (not placed, not away). A grounded reply can say yes with confidence and cite real capacity; a groundless one must hedge.
why: capacity is derived roster state; never in any email

subject: Small dogs available?
body:
Hello! My partner and I are hoping to adopt a small dog. Do you have any available right now? We can come to an event or make an appointment — whatever works. Thank you!

Priyanka
gt_facts: 15 small dogs are posted and in foster right now, incl. Aurora + Vetch (chihuahua mixes), Cumulus (terrier mix), Drizzle (poodle mix), Doldrum/Gale (spaniel mixes), Sorrel/Elderberry/Graupel (heeler mixes), etc. Good reply names several real ones + the adoption path (event / den appointment).

subject: Back in town — ready for another pup
body:
Hi! Back from my trip and the house feels empty. Ready for another foster whenever you need me — anyone waiting on a home right now?

Liam
gt_facts: Liam is a real foster (returned Typhoon 9/24, currently free). TRUE answer: zero dogs currently need placement — everyone is in a foster home; next weekly shelter pull is the obvious next chance. A grounded reply states that confidently (negative-space claim) and keeps Liam warm; a groundless one can't prove 'none' and may hedge or overpromise.
why: proving an absence; search cannot enumerate it

subject: Wednesday drop-off time?
body:
Quick one — what time is drop-off at the den for Wednesday's spay day again? And food cutoff is midnight, right, or is it morning?

Mirela
gt_facts: Cached in every vet blast: den drop-off 6:30AM (volunteers drive both ways); ALL food and water stops at midnight. (Overnight-after-9PM and direct-at-clinic 7:30AM options also exist.)
why: single cached answer; connector-class strength — control
